Call recap:
- Use case: inference for customer support routing + embeddings for knowledge search.
- Expected start volume: pilot ~100k tokens/day, aim to scale in Q3.

Open items / asks for Acme:
- Procurement path: do you want to purchase via PO (invoice) or corporate card? Any marketplace preference (AWS Marketplace) to simplify procurement?
- Security: your team requested SOC 2 Type 2 report + DPA — attaching our standard questionnaire and DPA draft for review.
- Timeline: you mentioned aiming to complete procurement by end of Q2 — please confirm.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf (blanked stub)

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement route (PO vs card vs marketplace) and procurement contact.
2) Security team to review attached questionnaire and DPA; flag any gating questions (e.g., KMS/data residency).
3) If PO, send purchase order to procurement@redwood.com; if marketplace, we can provide the listing details and replace invoicing flow.

I can loop Rishi (commercial) on the procurement thread — Monica and I will support security questions.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acme.com>

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few quick answers from procurement/security:

- Procurement preference: PO (invoice) is our preferred route for new vendors. We try to avoid card unless there is an urgent need.
- Marketplace: we are open to AWS Marketplace if it avoids lengthy vendor onboarding, but we need to understand licensing/billing implications (invoice vs marketplace metering).
- Security: our security team requires SOC 2 Type 2 and an executed DPA. We'll also need the questionnaire completed — I'll put Tim (security) on the thread to surface any blockers.
- Timeline: target end of Q2 is correct — pilot approval by mid-May would be ideal.

Can you send sample contract language/PO terms and the SOC2 redacted report? Also if you can provide a short note on regional hosting and KMS options that would help security triage.

I'll coordinate internally and propose a time for procurement + security call next week.

— Daniel
Director, IT Procurement | Acme Corp
Daniel.Lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-26T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood inference - procurement & security follow-up

Thanks Daniel — attaching the SOC 2 redacted report and our standard DPA for review. Quick notes on the questions you raised:

- PO vs card vs marketplace:
  - PO (invoice): straightforward — we can accept a PO and invoice Net30 by default; PO sent to billing@redwood.com.
  - Card: supported for small pilots, but procurement prefers PO for enterprise.
  - AWS Marketplace: we do have an AWS Marketplace listing (metered and SaaS options). Marketplace sales may have different invoicing timing and fees — we can route to our marketplace team if you prefer that path.

- Regional hosting & KMS:
  - We support region pinning (e.g., us-east-1) on Private deployments and offer customer-managed KMS integrations in Private and Dedicated configurations. For hosted/managed customers we provide recommended KMS options and can discuss contract language for key controls.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026_redacted.pdf, Standard_DPA.pdf

I'll let Rishi pick up on the commercial routing and can schedule a procurement call — what days work for you next week?

Best,
Marissa

Let's take the procurement + security call at 2027-03-29 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite with attendees from procurement and security.
